description: Adds an action the maker did outside upTake (a post, a newsletter, a talk) to the journal, so upTake measures what it brought.

date.description: Day of the action, YYYY-MM-DD. Default: today.

network.description: Network or place of the action: x, linkedin, reddit, newsletter…

project.description: Which project: its id or site (example.com) from uptake_projects. Optional when the maker has a single project.

title.description: What the maker did ("Posted the v1.4 thread on X").

name: uptake_log_action
title: Log an action
